ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is the “Comparison Chart of the Total Amount of Solar Radiation in China and the Global Total at the Same Latitudes”; the horizontal axis represents latitude, and the vertical axis represents the annual total amount of solar radiation. It can be seen in the figure that the annual total amount of solar radiation curve near the corresponding latitudes of southeastern China is lower than the global average level at the same latitudes. Then reason: the question asks for the main reason. Southeastern China belongs to the humid monsoon climate region and is obviously affected by the summer monsoon, with much precipitation, much overcast and rainy weather, and a relatively large amount of cloud cover. Clouds and precipitation reflect, absorb, and scatter solar radiation, weakening the solar radiation that reaches the ground, so the annual total amount of solar radiation is lower than the global average at the same latitudes.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读出该图是在比较我国与全球同纬度年太阳辐射总量，确认我国东南地区对应纬度的年太阳辐射总量低于同纬度全球平均。再结合题干问“主要原因”，调用我国区域气候知识：东南地区为湿润季风气候区，降水多、阴雨天多、云量大。最后用太阳辐射传输规则说明云雨天气削弱太阳辐射，因此答案为云雨天气多。
